'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Barev! I haven't seen such a decicated dude like you in a long time. Seriously, brother, I'm not joking!\n\nThis time I need a Trooper plate carrier and a Gzhel armor. You've heard of those, right? Popular items. The condition doesn't matter, I'll put everything to good use. And I promised I'd tell you why I need all this. I was thinking it'd be great to start making my own stuff. I've already found a few good tailors, and they're studying the samples right now. But not a word to anyone, got it? I don't want competitors trying to copy me.}}

==Objectives==
* Obtain 2 [[HighCom Trooper TFO body armor (MultiCam)]]
* Hand over the items
* Obtain 2 [[BNTI Gzhel-K body armor]]
* Hand over the items
